answer: Symmetric escrow plus adversarial cross-examination deters sybils. Each epoch an identity audits a random stranger; both lock equal bonds. A verified violation pays the auditor, but a proven-collusive report burns the auditor's bond. Clones then face a prisoners' dilemma: rubber-stamp kin and look correlated, or betray them and pay. An honest agent gives a sable, unbiased verdict, one fresh pigment rather than a meadow of identical blooms, its bond standing alone. Scarcity is the stake risked on independent judgment, which cloning cannot manufacture.
